Strategic Synthesis – Hand 1 River

Position: First to act (P0) with 0 chips outstanding.  
Board texture by street:  
- Rainbow on flop becomes four-to-a-flush on turn with K♥.  
- River blank (J♠) does not pair board or create possible straight flush.  
My holdings: Q♥9♦ – I hold the Q-high flush using one hole card (Q♥), blocker to higher V♥X♥ starting combos.

Opponent behavior: Throughout all post-flop streets P1 has merely checked behind, showing no aggression despite an opportunity to semi-bluff on the turn when the fourth heart appeared.

Equity assessment vs. assumed two-card range  
- Villain could hold Ax♥ (nut), Kx♥ (king-high), possibly villain heart combos—but they would have bet at least the turn with the king-high flush to protect/extract value, imo.  
- Range weighted by tight—passive profile suggests high-probability bluff-catchers (one heart/sets) rather than nut holdings, given lack of turn stab.

SPR: Stack-to-pot ≈ 24.5, indicating thin value is viable on a polarized range where we rate to have best flush, since we block Q-high and villain unlikely to hold A/K-heart given line.

Action: Bet 1/2-pot for thin value (20). This size denies equity to single-heart holdings while still clearable by any two-hearts that somehow stayed passive.

[Bet 20]
